t: The Elegant Trap: When Duplicate-Prevention Logic Works Too Well
s: A subtle bug in Pipulate's state management arose from overly aggressive duplicate prevention logic, where session keys persisted across server restarts, causing intended welcome messages to be suppressed. The fix involved clearing these session keys on startup to allow fresh messages.
sub: Server-side state management in local-first applications
Debugging race conditions in asynchronous systems
Git forensics and database inspection for root cause analysis
Overly effective duplicate prevention leading to feature absence
Surgical state management for resolving emergent complexity
